text:
Lina - Partnerships: quick sync — ACME HW partner asked for our SOC/pen artifacts to complete their marketplace listing. timeline?
Eric - Security: hey, have we committed to handing over full pen report or a redacted executive summary? legal may prefer redaction.
Marta - Legal: prefer redacted pen + attestation letter, not raw vuln details. we can include CVE IDs and mitigations, but redact PoCs and internal IP.
Jonas - Solutions: noted. partners expect a presigned S3 bundle. we should standardize the bundle layout: /compliance/{partner}/SOC2_report.pdf, /compliance/{partner}/pen-redacted.zip, /compliance/{partner}/questionnaire_answers.json
Priya - SI Eng: i can own packaging + presign. need pointer to pen redact rules and who signs attestation. cc @Marta. also need contact email at ACME and ingestion S3 path.
Lina - Partnerships: ACME contact is rachel@acme-hw.com. timeline: they want artifacts by EOD next wed for the marketplace window. can we hit that? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Eric - Security: pen team can produce redacted zip by Tue if we prioritize. SOC2 PDF already exists (2024-09).
Marta - Legal: i will draft a 1-paragraph attestation template today. sign-off chain: Security -> Legal -> Partnerships.
Jonas - Solutions: Priya — for presign TTL, i'd recommend 7 days and a one-time upload token. infra-bot, can you create a presign with 7d expiry for bucket redaction-upload?
infra-bot: presign request received. creating temporary credentials and upload path: s3://redwood-compliance-staging/acme-hw/1830009876-upload/ — presign link TTL set to 168h.
Priya - SI Eng: perfect. i'll put upload instructions in the bundle readme and include an md5 check. sample command:
```
curl -X PUT "{PRESIGN_URL}" --upload-file pen-redacted.zip -H "Content-Type: application/zip"
```
Lina - Partnerships: status check tomorrow morning. i'll follow up with ACME to confirm they accept redacted package + attestation. include a note that raw PoCs not shared.
Eric - Security: one more: flag any artifact that mentions partner-specific keys. we'll scrub those.
Marta - Legal: confirm we keep audit trail of who downloaded the presigned artifacts — set S3 access logging + retention 90 days.
Jonas - Solutions: i'll add a tiny validation script to verify expected files before presign final link. will post link to repo in this thread.
Lina - Partnerships: thanks team — pushing this to high priority. :rocket: 
Priya - SI Eng: assigning myself as owner for packaging + upload. will post progress by EOD tomorrow.
Lina - Partnerships: ACK.
